root_cause_analysis.symptom: Codex Bash/tool-call and subagent transcript rendering is less complete than current Claude Code rendering in Happy dev.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The Codex path loses structured command result fields, wrapper turn attribution, gated child-thread identity, and root-vs-child final_answer lifecycle boundaries before the app can normalize/reduce them into Claude-equivalent Bash ToolCall.result and sidechain contracts. Specifically, codexAppServerClient currently lets any agentMessage.phase=final_answer call emitRawTurnCompletion; after child threadId propagation, that would allow child final answers to emit top-level task_complete/turn-end and clear parent turn linkage.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: Not a single bisected regression; related prior commits include dd963663, 0ba2ddfc, 4381eaf5, 5c7a234f. QA rejection artifacts docs/dev/ba-qa-report-20260428-112122-codex-claude-transcript-parity.json and docs/dev/ba-qa-report-20260428-112122-codex-claude-transcript-parity-r2.json triggered this amendment.
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Prior work activated Codex renderers and separately improved Claude Agent/Task rendering, but did not make Claude's normalized data-flow a strict Codex transport contract.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Mapper/UI-only changes cannot render output/status/children that are not emitted, schema-accepted, normalized, or linked to the same sidechain identity; and ungated child final_answer completion would prematurely close/misattribute the parent/root turn while attempting to render child content.

transport_contract.decision: Extend command/Bash completion transport with an explicit structured result object, e.g. tool-call-end.result; retain ev.output string for legacy compatibility.
transport_contract.forbidden: Do not encode required Bash result/status fields solely in metadata, raw JSON dev detail, or stringified JSON output. Do not force structured object results onto spawn-agent final answers unless renderer support is explicitly updated and tested.
